name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly and easily find nearby recycling facilities based on their location or specific search criteria.
The User seeks to view detailed information about recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and contact details.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and other relevant community initiatives.
The User wants to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities, tracking their recycling activities, and receiving tailored recommendations.
The User aims to easily submit feedback, ask questions, and report issues to improve the overall recycling service.
The Administrator aims to ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current, correct, and comprehensive.
The Administrator seeks to efficiently review, categorize, and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to enhance user satisfaction.
The Administrator is committed to protecting all user and facility data from unauthorized access, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain clear communication channels with facility representatives to coordinate updates and address issues.
The Facility Representative aims to easily and accurately update their facility's operational hours, accepted materials, and other relevant details.
The Facility Representative seeks a direct and effective way to convey any operational issues or concerns to the site administrators for resolution.
The Superuser aims to provide the most current and accurate information about recycling centers to users by having elevated update privileges.
The Superuser seeks to efficiently answer user questions related to recycling centers, leveraging their elevated access to information.
lowLevelGoals: The User can initiate a search to find recycling facilities near their current location by providing their GPS coordinates to the system.
The User can input a specific address or zip code to find recycling facilities within that geographical area.
The User can refine their search for recycling facilities by selecting specific material types (e.g., plastic, paper, glass) they wish to recycle.
The User can view the search results for recycling facilities plotted on an interactive map.
The User can select a specific recycling facility from a list or map to view its comprehensive details.
The User can see the opening and closing times for a chosen recycling facility.
The User can view which types of materials (e.g., plastics, paper, electronics) are accepted at a particular recycling facility.
The User can retrieve the phone number, email address, and website link for a chosen recycling facility.
The User can opt-in to receive alerts about new recycling events or special waste drop-off initiatives.
The User can customize their notification settings to receive alerts only for events related to certain materials or within a defined geographical area.
The User can access a calendar or list displaying all upcoming recycling events.
The User can mark a specific recycling facility as a favorite for quick access in the future.
The User can access a dedicated section showing all the recycling facilities they have marked as favorites.
The User can record their recycling actions, including when and where they recycled, and what materials were involved.
The User can review a chronological record of all their logged recycling activities.
The User can send general feedback or suggestions to the platform administrators through a dedicated form.
The User can flag problems or inaccuracies related to a particular recycling facility, such as incorrect hours or unaccepted materials.
The User can submit a query or request for information to the platform's support or administrative team.
The Administrator can input all necessary details to create a new entry for a recycling facility.
The Administrator can modify any details (e.g., address, hours, accepted materials) of an already listed recycling facility.
The Administrator can delete an outdated or incorrect entry for a recycling facility.
The Administrator can review and decide whether to accept or decline changes submitted for facility information.
The Administrator can access a centralized interface displaying all feedback, questions, and issue reports from users.
The Administrator can assign labels or types to incoming user feedback for better organization and prioritization.
The Administrator can delegate user feedback items to appropriate personnel for investigation and response.
The Administrator can compose and send a reply to a user who has submitted feedback or a question.
The Administrator ensures that all data exchanged between users, facilities, and the platform is encrypted to prevent interception.

The Administrator can define and assign specific permissions to different user roles (e.g., User, Facility Representative, Administrator, Superuser) to restrict access to sensitive data and functionalities.
The Administrator can enable and review logs that record every change made to facility or user data, including who made the change and when.
The Administrator can initiate and maintain encrypted communication with facility representatives for data updates and issue resolution.
The Administrator can broadcast important announcements or requests for information to a group of facility representatives simultaneously.
The Administrator can send targeted requests to a facility representative for updates on particular data points (e.g., new accepted materials, temporary closures).
The Facility Representative can send a request to modify the opening and closing times of their facility.
The Facility Representative can send a request to add or remove materials that their facility accepts for recycling.
The Facility Representative can send a request to change the phone number, email, or website associated with their facility.
The Facility Representative can check whether their update requests have been approved, rejected, or are still pending.
The Facility Representative can communicate specific problems or concerns about their facility's operations directly to the administrators.
The Facility Representative can notify administrators about any incorrect or outdated information displayed for their facility on the platform.
The Superuser can directly edit any piece of information for any recycling facility without requiring an approval process.
The Superuser can apply changes to facility data instantly, making them visible to users without delay.
The Superuser can view a list of all questions submitted by users that require a response.
The Superuser can write and send a reply to a user's question, utilizing their comprehensive knowledge of facility information.
The Superuser can indicate that a user's question has been answered and no further action is required.
